iWant: the check-ins I pick to reach my own Squire and nothing else
soThat: a wake-up never lands in the wrong place, and when Squire is not sure, nothing is sent
description: A wake-up fires, Squire finds its own session, and either sends or records "not sent" with the reason.
title: Wake-ups reach only the Squire owner's own session

acceptanceCriteria.description: A wake-up reaches only the Squire owner's own session; when Squire cannot be sure which session is its own, it sends nothing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A wake-up the Squire owner picked comes due
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire looks for its own session and finds exactly one, none, or more than one candidate
acceptanceCriteria.then: With exactly one, the wake-up is delivered to that session; with none or more than one, nothing is sent and the log says why.
